runtime_connector_id.description: Optional connector id copied to agent_config.runtime_connector_id and sent as x-connector-id for Edge runtime endpoints.

runtime_secret.description: Phase 1 lab compatibility bridge copied to agent_config.runtime_secret. Prefer runtime_secret_file or runtime_secret_keychain_* for endpoint tests so the managed profile does not embed the secret value.

runtime_secret_file.description: Optional device-local file path copied to agent_config.runtime_secret_file. The Local Client reads the secret from this file when runtime_secret is absent.

runtime_secret_keychain_service.description: Optional macOS Keychain generic-password service name copied to agent_config.runtime_secret_keychain_service.

runtime_secret_keychain_account.description: Optional macOS Keychain generic-password account copied to agent_config.runtime_secret_keychain_account.

fetch_trusted_keyring.description: When true, the Local Client fetches the tenant trusted keyring from Edge after device registration before validating the policy bundle.

network_extension_rules_path.description: Optional path to generated network_extension_steering_rules.v1 manifest distributed with the agent for transparent steering.

network_extension_runtime_evidence_path.description: Optional path copied to agent_config.network_extension_runtime_evidence_ref. Phase 1 uses this for not-installed/runtime evidence separation; production providers should write this evidence locally.

local_proxy_metrics_url.description: Optional local proxy /metrics URL copied to agent_config.local_proxy_metrics_url for proxy-based steering telemetry.
